cn_apply_skin_confirm_description: The skin shows on your screen alone; every other player still sees the skin the server named. Applying it adds the skin to a local patch the injection host loads when the game starts, so this is done at your own risk.
cn_auto_restore_done: The client starts on its own again
cn_auto_waiting_label: Champ-select follow · waiting for a pick…
cn_description: Champions and skins as the Chinese client's own tables list them, and a skin you can pick to show on your own screen through the injection host.
cn_error_game_already_running: The game is already open. Start injection first, then launch the game.
cn_error_game_still_running: Close the game before stopping injection.
cn_error_game_window_missing: No game window answered in 30 minutes. Start injection first, then play a game, and the host finds it on its own.
cn_error_hook_refused: The game refused the hook. Close the game and start injection again before the next one.
cn_error_hook_timeout: The game window answered, but the DLL never loaded into it. Restart the game and try again.
cn_error_injector_load: The injection host could not load its DLL, most likely removed or blocked by an antivirus.
cn_error_loader_dll_missing: The loader's DLL is missing, most likely removed by an antivirus. Reinstalling VinciSkin puts it back.
cn_error_loader_running: Another injection loader is already running. Stop it first.
cn_error_uac_cancelled: You cancelled the administrator prompt, so nothing was changed.
cn_force_stop_done: Loader ended. League starts on its own again.
cn_force_stop_failed_description: It is still running. Close the game, then try again.
cn_force_stop_hint: Ends vinciskin-inj.exe even when VinciSkin did not start it, which is what a leftover loader does to the next game
cn_inject_idle_label: Injection host off · skins won't show
cn_inject_injected_label: Injected · waiting for the game to exit
cn_inject_off_game_running_label: Injection off — the game is running, so this match won't change
cn_inject_scanning_label: Waiting for the game to start…
cn_load_started_description: The skin is in the local patch, so it shows on your screen once the game starts.
cn_pack_applied_description: Added {count} archives to the local patch. Launch the game to see it.
cn_pack_drifted_notice: A game patch or repair changed one of these archives since the pack was written, so it is not put back by hand. Forget the record to start over.
cn_pack_forget_confirm_description: The game's files are left alone; only the manager's record of this archive is dropped.
cn_pack_import_confirm_description: The archives the pack names are added whole to the local patch; the game's own files are left alone. Put one back from the list at any time.
cn_pack_import_confirm_title: Add this skin pack to the local patch?
cn_pack_stage_complete: Written; the game shows it from the next launch
cn_packs_description: Add a downloaded `.fantome` or `.wad.client` to the local patch for the champion archives it names.
cn_packs_empty: No skin pack has been added yet.
cn_restore_skin_failed_title: Couldn't put the champion's own skin back
cn_risk_notice: The skin is loaded through the injected patch and never written into the game's own files. Start the injection host before launching the game, and use it at your own risk.
cn_select_hero_hint: Pick a champion to list its skins
cn_skin_applied: Applied: {name}. Launch the game to see it.
cn_skin_applied_game_running_description: This match won't change. Close the game, start injection, and launch again.
cn_skin_applied_injection_off_descriptio: Start injection before launching the game, or the game reads its own archive.
cn_skin_reset: The champion's own skin is back.
cn_skins_empty: This champion has no skins in the Chinese client's table
cn_skins_filtered_empty: No skin of this champion matches the filters
cn_swap_backup_missing_notice: The backup this record names is gone, so the champion's own skin cannot be put back. Forget the record to start over.
cn_swap_drifted_notice: The archive is not in the state the record left it in, so it is not written over. Forget the record to start over.
cn_swap_forget_confirm_description: The game's files are left alone; only the manager's record of this champion is dropped. The skin it was last given stays remembered.
cn_swap_reverted_notice: The client put its own archive back, so this swap is gone. Applying again is safe.
